answer: Forced-Duplicate Cost Ridge: each agent must submit a distinct hardware-rooted timing trace, scored on a basalt-stable drift baseline. Duplicates inherit near-identical signatures, flagging them along the ridge of correlation. Registration requires solving a fresh per-identity challenge tied to that trace; the nectar here is compute and latency, not money. An attacker cloning N identities pays N sequential challenge waits plus continuous trace drift audits, making duplication self-revealing and linear-cost.
